items: Massive storage with Microsoft 365 included – Equipped with a 128GB fast SSD for quick boot and smooth file access. Enjoy full access to Word, Excel, PowerPoint and more, ideal for school and home use.
4GB RAM for Basic Everyday Use – Designed for simple tasks like web browsing, email, and online classes. A budget-friendly option for light users and students.
Intel Core Performance for Everyday Tasks – Powered by an Intel quad-core processor designed for reliable performance in web browsing, online classes, video streaming, and daily productivity tasks.

Lightweight & Portable for On-the-Go Use – Slim 14" design makes it easy to carry anywhere, whether to school, office, or travel. Energy-efficient design helps extend battery life for all-day everyday use.
Perfect for Students, Work & Home Use – Ideal for online learning, remote work, document editing, and entertainment. A great everyday laptop that balances performance, portability, and value.
